tools.name: url_to_markdown
tools.description: Extract clean, token-efficient Markdown from any public URL with headings, tables, code blocks, and links intact.

tools.name: generate_content_md
tools.description: Extract the core article or documentation body from any URL into a standardized CONTENT.md format, stripping headers, footers, and advertising noise.

tools.name: generate_design_md
tools.description: Extract a standardized DESIGN.md from any URL — CSS custom properties, typography hierarchy, button/card specifications, color palettes, and AI layout guidelines.

tools.name: generate_links_md
tools.description: Extract a complete link graph into a standardized LINKS.md format from any URL, separating internal routes from outbound citations and references with anchor text.
